req.title: Register form GET
req.statement: The system shall serve a registration form at GET /auth/register.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /auth/register must return an HTTP 2xx response with the registration form. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — a normal GET returns 200 with the form HTML; (2) negative NEG — a wrong HTTP method (POST with no data) still serves the form but with a flash error, confirming the route exists and method routing works; (3) boundary BVA — verifying the exact status code is 200 (not 201, not 302) and that key form fields (username, password inputs) are present in the response body; (4) STC — verifying that an unauthenticated client (no session) gets the form, not a redirect; (5) DT — verifying Content-Type header contains text/html. Each test uses exact-value assertions to maximise mutation kill rate.

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_register_get_returns_200():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/auth/register')
    assert r.status_code == 200

test_register_get_returns_200()

tests.name: test_register_get_unauthenticated_no_session_redirect
preconditions: Flask app is created in TESTING mode with a temporary database
Client has no active session (unauthenticated state)
actions: Send GET /auth/register with a fresh client (no cookies/session)
expected: HTTP status code is exactly 200 — unauthenticated users are served the form, not redirected
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_register_get_unauthenticated_no_session_redirect():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    # Ensure no session cookie is present
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        sess.clear()
    r = client.get('/auth/register', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert len(r.data) > 0

test_register_get_unauthenticated_no_session_redirect()
